prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: Original OpenTTD vehicle.model-17 ORBITAL CARGO HAULER, EMPTY, first physical model selection. This is an original general freight barge, not a mining craft or a construction robot.
Design one compact broad low elongated rectangular cargo-barge hull in pale-ivory ceramic/gunmetal with restrained muted TEAL structural panels. One shallow open recessed RECTANGULAR CARGO DECK in the center, bare dark steel floor EMPTY, with exactly TWO fixed low side cargo-retaining rails and a low front/rear sill. No cargo, crates, ore, tanks or carried materials in this empty pose. Floor must be visible and large enough for later genuine partial/full container loads, about40percent of whole top area, with a continuous simple rectangular interior and clearly readable foreground rail. ONE short solid command head at the FRONT with ONE small flat dark-navy diagnostic display on its upper sloped face, NO cockpit/windows/crew. Exactly ONE compact central cylindrical REAR maneuvering engine nozzle, unlit, behind the rear sill. No auxiliary engine/nozzle pairs, side booms, arms/grippers, cutter/drill/scanner dish, solar wings/antenna, loose hoses, guns/weapons or landing legs. Original broad cargo silhouette, clean simple equipment inventory, no decorative hardware clutter.
The front command head/display and rear engine must turn coherently with the actual physical camera. Same rectangular bay/deck, exactly2fixed side rails, one front command head/display, ONE rear nozzle in every view; no swapping a nozzle onto an unchanged nose. No exhaust/light/work/service, motionblur or company-color masking. Color palette avoids bright company-blue: calm ivory/gunmetal and muted teal. Original crisp detailed volumetric industrial isometric game machinery for native64x48 indexed DOS palette, world anchor(-32,-32). One fixed LOW elevated ORTHOGRAPHIC2:1 camera about26.565degrees above horizontal, upper-left SCREEN lighting constant, natural near/far rail occlusion, no flat bitmap rotation/mirroring.
Create four GENUINE physical cameras of this same EMPTY barge in a1536x1024 TRUE-TRANSPARENT2x2 sheet:
TOP LEFT N is a REAR view: front command head/navy display at far UPPER edge facing UP/AWAY, rear nozzle mouth at near LOWER center facing DOWN/TOWARD viewer. Deck lies between head at top and nozzle at bottom. Do not render another front-facing S view here.
TOP RIGHT NE is REAR-three-quarter: front head/display far UPPER-RIGHT, ONE rear nozzle near LOWER-LEFT. Same bare cargo deck and exactly2rails turn as one3D rig.
BOTTOM LEFT E side: FRONT command head/display RIGHT, ONE rear nozzle LEFT.
BOTTOM RIGHT SE front-three-quarter: front head/display near LOWER-RIGHT, rear nozzle far UPPER-LEFT.
Four opaque straight pure-magenta #FF00FF6px exterior separator rectangles at N(24,24)-(744,488),NE(792,24)-(1512,488),E(24,536)-(744,1000),SE(792,536)-(1512,1000). Each whole barge maximum520px wide/340px tall, one physical scale across all4views. Keep COMPLETE models safely inside N[64,64,704,448],NE[832,64,1472,448],E[64,576,704,960],SE[832,576,1472,960], with32px+ TRUE TRANSPARENT clearance to every frame. Reduce the whole model uniformly for clearance, never shorten a rail/engine separately. Empty panel interiors/margins/gutters actual alpha=0, no translucent magenta/purple haze, background, checkerboard, gray/white fill, ground plane/castshadow or glow. Do not overlap or clip subjects. No text/numbers/labels/arrows/watermark/otherprops. Same original EMPTY cargo barge, exact four genuine N/NE/E/SE cameras.
